sentences.2: But an effective DPIA can also bring broader compliance, financial and reputational benefits, helping you demonstrate accountability and building trust and engagement with individuals.
sentences.3: A DPIA must assess the necessity and proportionality of processing, including measures to ensure compliance and respect for GDPR principles.
sentences.4: For example, you may be able to demonstrate that consultation would compromise commercial confidentiality, undermine security, or be disproportionate or impracticable.
sentences.5: A DPIA does not require eradication of all risks but should help document risks and assess whether any remaining risks are justified.
sentences.6: But it should help you document them and assess whether or not any remaining risks are justified.
sentences.7: Controllers must submit the DPIA, documentation of responsibilities between controllers and processors, processing purposes and means, protective measures and safeguards, and DPO contact details when seeking prior consultation.
sentences.8: The Data Protection Impact Assessment and any ancillary documents;
